scope: 11 selected installed skills curated into the active source collection using skill-cutter and skill-creator conventions.
acceptance: Each selected skill is categorized and registered with matching semantic version, focused trigger and aligned UI; useful resources are retained, local links resolve, applicable validators and helper smoke checks pass, and catalogs/marketplace agree. Stop after delivering/publishing this reviewed import.

version_policy.gws: 0.22.5 source -> 0.22.6 compatible instruction revision; CLI generator version retained separately
version_policy.scientific-brainstorming: 1.4-local.2 -> 1.4.1 valid semantic version for the reviewed adaptation; original source version retained

helper_behavior: Scaffold preserves explicit date and pending state
Existing register is not overwritten without --force
Validator accepts the empty pending scaffold without implying scientific validation
Documented weighted-matrix example yields scores 65 and 60
Matrix retains qualitative evidence, four sensitivity scenarios, and no automatic decision

external_checks.scope: Upstream project/CLI discovery context; local installed +upload and files list help checked directly without Drive operations.
Public tool names and routing; this is not a full signature or statistical execution audit.
The historical 1.4.0 anchor exists; newer releases are available.

limitations: No live Drive transfer or account changes were performed.
No statistical fits, training runs, scientific reproduction, or independent model/agent review were performed.
VI publisher/DOI retrieval was unavailable; original source annotations were preserved as dated review provenance.
Optional brainstorming helpers are retained unchanged; static parsing and representative local CLI behavior checks do not establish scientific validity.
References are retained for concrete conditional workflows; they were not moved out of the entrypoint merely to improve its line count.

review.keep: Project-root/index/recap contracts, raw-data preservation, scientific boundary, merge rules, useful document templates.
review.condense: Bootstrap/resume/maintain/distill routing and proportional continuity checks.
review.remove: Duplicate authority taxonomy, mandatory companion-install offers, duplicated handoff skill template, repeated approval/completion rules.
review.trigger: Only requested project continuity or authorized skill distillation; excludes method selection and interpretation.
review.portability: English documentation/Chinese recap are explicit defaults, subordinate to project/user language choices; local discovery uses the target host convention.

review.keep: Drive IDs, resource keys, native export distinction, pagination completeness, retry/duplicate risk, shared-drive parameters.
review.condense: Common operations into a decision guide with live help/schema discovery.
review.remove: Generated full API resource catalog, deprecated teamdrives inventory, automatic skill regeneration.
review.trigger: Requested Drive API operations through gws; routes simple new-file uploads separately.

review.keep: Actual upload syntax, optional parent/name, new-item semantics, duplicate-safe retry, replacement via ID.
review.condense: Examples and flags into two commands plus operational constraints.
review.remove: Repeated blanket confirmation for an upload already requested.
review.trigger: New local-file upload; excludes overwrite and recursive synchronization.

review.keep: Authentication reuse, JSON argument serialization, binary output distinction, bounded pagination and dry-run limits.
review.condense: CLI discovery/flags into guidance that changes request construction.
review.remove: Repeated approval for all writes, generic installation advice, incorrect zsh quoting warning, promotional star/issue/comment instructions.
review.trigger: Shared gws mechanics, not any mention of a Google product.

review.keep: Unique OS-temporary destination, focus/state/authorization continuity, factual provenance, redaction, explicit-only invocation.
review.condense: Content and completion guidance without a transcript or duplicate project records.
review.remove: Assumption that every agent exposes a tool literally named Skill.
review.trigger: Explicit session transfer; excludes automatic project logging and underlying-task execution.

review.keep: Workflow table, count/representation provenance, independent replication, controls, MuData alignment, mutation/return semantics, version-aware API references.
review.condense: Discovery description only; expert reference detail was already useful and selectively routed.
review.remove: Any implication that the 1.4.0 snapshot is the latest package behavior.
review.trigger: Concrete pertpy workflow; excludes general Scanpy preprocessing and unrelated prediction frameworks.
review.limits: References preserve the 2026-10-08 review of pertpy 1.4.0. No full statistical workflows or new-release signature audit were run.

review.keep: Ideas versus evidence/decisions, actual participation/provenance, counterarguments, search limits, uncertainty and sensitivity, no automatic winner; MIT license and optional helper contracts.
review.condense: Ten-stage workshop and bias-control duplication into the requested ideation outcome; preserve existing selectively loaded method/evaluation references.
review.remove: Project-specific PertCCC coupling, fixed user paths, mandatory recap language across projects, promotional manuscript citation mandate, repeated workshop/approval rituals.
review.trigger: Requested scientific ideation/prioritization; excludes validation, clinical advice, or implied experimental execution.
review.limits: Helper smoke checks are deterministic and local. Preserved dated reference/policy summaries require current source checks when applied.

review.keep: Scientist-owned scientific choices, inferred analysis contract, raw-data/result preservation, anomaly diagnosis and separately corrected results, claim/evidence distinction.
review.condense: Authority, verification, interpretation, and output contracts into actionable sections.
review.remove: All-research-code catchall, categorical approvals for routine Git/classes/refactors/tests despite established task scope, repeated anti-overdefense examples.
review.trigger: Research implementation that can affect scientific meaning/results; excludes unrelated mechanical edits.
review.limits: A larger entrypoint exposes the essential boundary without forcing every user to preload the full policy; total folder words fall substantially.

review.keep: Work/right/practice sequence, data/domain-first design, useful behavior checks, root-cause correction, state ownership, idempotence, scoped cleanup and Git workflow.
review.condense: Repeated engineering slogans into focused decisions.
review.remove: Mandatory external tool scores and mutation runs, action-by-action logs, automatic push-to-main, redundant installation README.
review.trigger: Explicitly chosen reduced coding principles; no automatic process for every edit.

review.keep: Explicit joint/q/objective/query, identification assumptions, measurement support/missingness, gradient ownership, claim-specific validation and framework/version references.
review.condense: Repeated modeling cautions and routing while retaining the equation/design references and brief template.
review.remove: Originating private project paths and repeated ceremony; no scientific method or helper contract was replaced.
review.trigger: VI/VAE method formulation, implementation, review, or framework integration; excludes routine model use.
review.limits: Original paper-review annotations are historical provenance. Publisher/DOI fetches were unavailable during this import, so the paper analyses were not independently reverified or reproduced.

review.keep: Recursive traversal and pagination, folder/file ID accounting, native exports, shortcut cycles, untrusted names, destination preservation, safe retry and verification.
review.condense: File/tree transfer and verification into a portable configured-CLI workflow.
review.remove: Personal account and OAuth identifiers, credential locations, user/machine executable paths, disk UUID/default storage, historical local test narrative.
review.trigger: Requested transfers with configured gws; excludes provisioning, sharing changes, and deletion synchronization.
review.portability: Retain the historical stable ID; all operator/account/storage setup stays in private runtime configuration.
